title: Chicken Caprese
description: In this chicken caprese recipe, boneless chicken breasts are topped with spinach, tomato, and buffalo mozzarella with a touch of balsamic vinegar.
ingredients: 2 (4 ounce) balls of buffalo mozzarella, sliced
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook until slightly softened, about 2 minutes, stirring often. Add spinach; toss with oil and garlic. Cover, remove from heat, and set aside until spinach wilted.

Heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in an oven-safe skillet. Add chicken breasts; cook until browned, about 4 minutes per side. Season with salt. Layer 1/4 each wilted spinach, tomato slices, and mozzarella slices on each breast. Season with black pepper and drizzle with balsamic vinegar.

Bake in the preheated oven until cheese browned and chicken is no longer pink inside, about 15 minutes. An instant-read meat thermometer inserted into thickest parts of breasts should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
